topic.label: American Studies
topic.desc: American Studies: interdisciplinary study of the culture, history, politics and identities of the United States and its place in the world.

concepts: Changing ideas, values and everyday life in the United States from the colonial era to the present.
Novels, poetry, essays and documents read as evidence of American culture and ideology.
Film, television, music, advertising and digital media as producers of American meaning.
How race, ethnicity, Indigeneity and immigration have shaped American identity and citizenship.
Gender roles, sexuality and class formation in American society and culture.
American regions, cities, landscapes and the United States as a global and imperial power.
skills: Writes a synthesis of an American historical period and checks every claim against cited primary and secondary sources.
Analyses a letter, speech or artifact for context and meaning and checks dating and provenance against archival records.
Examines a national myth such as the frontier or the American dream and checks the reading against scholarship.
Produces a close reading of an American literary text and checks each claim against textual evidence.
Identifies ideological assumptions in a text or document and checks the critique for evidence and counter-readings.
Traces how a work entered or left the American canon and checks the account against publishing and teaching records.
Analyses a film or television series for themes and form and checks interpretation against production context.
Analyses advertisements as evidence of consumer culture and checks dates and sources in archives.
Summarises audience reception of a media text and checks the summary against survey and review evidence.
Analyses an immigration wave and its policy context and checks figures against census and legal records.
Reviews laws and court cases on citizenship and race and checks holdings against the case text.
Reviews Indigenous histories and perspectives on a topic and checks the account against Indigenous scholarship.
Analyses class formation and labor struggles and checks the analysis against labor history sources.
Applies feminist and queer analysis to a cultural text and checks claims against the text and scholarship.
Summarises historical data on family and work patterns and checks figures against census series.
Characterises the culture of an American region such as the South and checks the profile against regional scholarship.
Maps urban and suburban change and checks the map against census and planning data.
Analyses United States foreign policy as empire and checks the claims against diplomatic records and scholarship.
mcp: Enhance responses with scholarly research and citations
